action.objective: Push a7, secure the pawn, keep rook on c7 pressing the back rank
action.rationale: a6a7 is the only commit_ready move, verified depth-4 single-candidate search score 25 with full mate-in-one safety check (no mating reply). Broad depth-3 search also rated it best (exact 25). Alternatives (c7c6, h2e2) had only upper bounds at shallower evidence. a7 attacks b8, and after Bxa7 the c7 rook can still harass Black's king. Small edge but positionally sound.
